title: File the Texas franchise tax report
summary: File each Texas entity's annual franchise tax and information reports by the due date.
outlineSteps: List each Texas entity and its taxpayer number
Confirm each entity's due date and filing status
Gather the year's revenue and the ownership details the reports ask for
Decide the report type with the tax preparer
Update officer, manager and registered agent information
Prepare the franchise tax report and the information report
File each report and pay any tax due
Confirm each entity shows in good standing with the state
Record the filings and set next year's reminders
